title: Nexus RunListResponse
description: Response for GET /v1/daemon/compute/runs — cursor-paginated list of compute runs for the active creator (V1.147 P0 direct lane).

items.description: Array of RunSummary rows, ordered by created_at descending.

has_more.description: True when another page exists (equivalent to next_cursor being non-null).

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Clients MUST NOT parse it. Non-null only when has_more is true.
